newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-ECI rated aggressive buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ECI rated aggressive buy.

text.p: UBS Ltd said on Monday it rates ECI Telecom an aggressive buy after the company's third-quarter earnings were in line with expectations while the stock is currently trading at "cheap" levels.

"At 10 times 1997 and nine times 1998 estimated earnings, ECI trades at a sharp discount to its 15-20 percent sustainable growth rate over the next several years," analyst Daniel Carasso said in a report.
He said the current stock price reflects expectations that there will be no significant turnaround at the Israeli company's Telematics subsidiary.
BUT UBS believes Telematics' results will improve significantly through 1997, which should boost the stock to $30-$35 over the next 12-24 months.
ECI is currently trading at $19-5/8, down from a 52-week high of $28.
UBS estimates the telecommunications equipment maker will earn $1.33 in 1996, $1.70-$1.75 in 1997 and $2.00-$2.05 in 1998.
